integrity: The proof uses the source's exact fiber-divisibility and multisection-degree theorem plus the standard characteristic parity \(c_1\bmod 2=w_2\) and the Wu formula. The source is primarily classified as Geometric Topology; the ledger records the permitted top-level MSC 57 and does not invent a finer code.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for positive relatively minimal Lefschetz fibrations over \(S^2\) in the source's conventions and fiber genus at least two. It proves primitivity only in genus two and does not settle the \(2\)-section question for genus at least four.
title: Fiber divisibility divides \(g-1\) for positive Lefschetz fibrations
